Athena Capital founder and managing partner Isabelle Freidheim discusses what Anthropic’s potential $1.4 trillion valuation says about the growth of private markets, and how its debut could create a path for other late-stage technology companies to go public. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
